manifest.study_scope: Literal full-message cost only; no comprehension, forecast-accuracy or adoption claim.
manifest.test_set_note: Prospective ORIGINAL, not a replication or edit of withdrawn 86cda0b8. Sixteen newly authored fictional reports with stipulated predictions; convenience sample, not real usage. Eight tells-apart (five favour held, three rival, two with satisfied explicit domains), four fits-both, four fits-neither (two equal, two unequal predictions). Both full strings are priced, including byte-identical shared context naming held and rival readings. English gives both predictions and the same reported outcome once in concise prose; logical conclusions already entailed by these statements are not expanded into extra prose. The same domain restriction occurs in both arms when present. Counts cover only test_set.english and test_set.ainglish, not IDs, form labels or this metadata. No definition/tutorial cost, reader accuracy, deployment overhead, natural-use frequency or future-tokenizer claim. The one fixed English template is not claimed globally shortest. No tokenizer loaded or preview counts consulted before mint; no selection, revision or omission after counting. All outcomes retained. Per-form means are descriptive only, not settlement strata. This separately declared secondary study does not complete the live comprehension task.
